question: Should this issue remain the primary tracker for successful browser authorization not resuming, or should that behavior be consolidated into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/issues/724 after a current-LKG reproduction?
rationale: Both reports point to the same device-code state machine, but recent collaborator tracking preserves them separately and current-version evidence is insufficient to select one canonical issue automatically.

options.title: Reproduce then consolidate
options.body: Test both completion and expiry against the currently pinned gateway, then keep the issue whose transcript best captures the confirmed root cause.

options.title: Keep separate outcomes
options.body: Retain this issue for successful authorization not resuming and the related issue for expiry incorrectly allowing configuration to continue.

recommendation.title: Reproduce then consolidate
recommendation.body: Test both completion and expiry against the currently pinned gateway, then keep the issue whose transcript best captures the confirmed root cause.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the active provider-onboarding tracking context and most recently reopened both reports.
